threats.title: Geolocation Service Spoofing / Man-in-the-Middle
threats.description: A rogue service impersonates Mapping/Geolocation API to return incorrect routes, inflated distances, or wrong ETAs to process 2.0 Request Ride.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.3 with strict API key restriction and certificate pinning on outbound mapping calls.

threats.title: Unauthorized Payment Processor Impersonation
threats.description: A malicious rogue gateway impersonates Payment Processor to receive Charge request data or return fake success status payloads to the backend.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication and verify webhooks/responses using cryptographic signature headers.

threats.title: Driver Identity Spoofing / Rogue Driver
threats.description: An unverified or malicious individual logs in using a compromised Driver account to accept rides, falsify locations, or harvest rider contact details.
threats.mitigation: Implement mandatory identity verification checks (e.g., biometric facial scan prompts), device fingerprinting, and mTLS for driver app connections.

threats.title: Rider Identity Spoofing / Credential Compromise
threats.description: An attacker steals or guesses a legitimate Rider account credential to log in and request fraudulent rides, billing trips to the victim's saved payment method.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), strict password policies, and rate-limiting on login attempts.

threats.title: Unauthorized Price Manipulation / Fare Calculation Bypass
threats.description: An attacker tampers with session state or parameters in 5.0 Process Fare to calculate zero or negative fare values before sending payment requests.
threats.mitigation: Perform all fare and discount calculations strictly server-side, verifying total amounts against immutable database records before requesting charges.

threats.title: Denial of Service via Automated Ride Request Flooding
threats.description: Bot networks submit thousands of fake ride requests to 2.0 Request Ride, exhausting application threads and overloading DS-03: Location Cache
threats.mitigation: Implement rate-limiting per account/IP, geo-fencing validation, and CAPTCHA challenges on high-frequency request rates.

threats.title: GPS Telemetry Spoofing / Distance Tampering
threats.description: A compromised driver sends false GPS coordinates to 4.0 Track Trip to artificially inflate trip distance, duration, and final fare calculations.
threats.mitigation: Cross-verify reported driver GPS telemetry with mapping API route interpolation algorithms to flag anomalous speed or location jumps.

threats.title: Manipulation of Driver-Rider Matching Algorithm Logic
threats.description: An attacker tampers with internal parameters or state inside 3.0 Match Driver to favor specific rogue drivers or bypass proximity checks.
threats.mitigation: Isolate matching algorithm business logic in secure app containers and enforce strict integrity checks on proximity parameters read from cache.

threats.title: SQL Injection in User Authentication Query Path
threats.description: An attacker passes malicious SQL strings through credential fields to process 1.0 Authenticate User, attempting to alter queries executed against DS-01: User Profiles DB.
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) or ORM frameworks and hash passwords with Argon2id.
